source_original_stem_ABC.stem: Capacitatea de serviciu Cs a unei linii electrice aeriene simetrice, având capacităţile C12=C23=C31 =C şi neglijînd influenţa pământului, este:

cases.original_question_scope: Line capacitances between each pair C12=C23=C31=C, earth effects neglected; phrase 'capacitate de serviciu Cs' does not explicitly define terminal/sequence equivalent.
cases.math_proof: For a balanced three-phase system Va+Vb+Vc=0: qa=C(Va−Vb)+C(Va−Vc)=C(2Va−Vb−Vc)=3C Va, so equivalent positive-sequence star phase capacitance is 3C. If sum zero is not true or Cs denotes a different quantity, equality needs extra modeling.
cases.negative_test: For Va=1, Vb=0.2, Vc=0.5 (not balanced), qa=C*(2−0.2−0.5)=1.3C, not 3C.

ABC.A: 3C follows only for stated balanced phase-to-neutral equivalent; affirmative candidate, not a certified exam key.
ABC.B: C/3 fails the balanced delta-to-star phase-equivalent charge relation.
ABC.C: C is one mutual phase-to-phase partial capacitance, not the balanced equivalent phase-to-neutral service capacitance under that definition.

references.qualification: Secondary didactic derivation published 2026, corroborates algebra but cannot authenticate ANRE original scoring.

cases.next_gate: Obtain original exact course definition of Cs and grade-specific ANRE key/revision evidence.

source_original_stem_ABC.stem: În cazul unei scheme cu două bare colectoare şi un întreruptor pe circuit este de preferat ca în regim normal de funcţionare:
source_original_stem_ABC.A: una dintre barele colectoare să fie sub tensiune, cealaltă bară fiind menţinută în rezervă rece;
source_original_stem_ABC.B: ambele bare colectoare să fie sub tensiune, cupla transversală fiind menţinută în funcţiune;
source_original_stem_ABC.C: ambele bare colectoare să fie menţinute sub tensiune, cupla transversală fiind în rezervă caldă.

cases.original_question_scope: Two busbars, one breaker per circuit, asks 'este de preferat' in normal operation; supply topology, loads, reserve restoration philosophy and operating policy are unstated.
cases.math_proof: No scalar physical equation establishes 'preferable' among A/B/C. Two-busbar schemes can be run with one working bar and reserve bus or with both busbars energized; the coupler standby configuration differs by local system design.
cases.negative_test: Existence of at least two documented technically feasible normal schemes refutes inference of a universally uniquely preferable arrangement from topology alone.

ABC.A: One live bus and other cold reserve can be an operating regime, but no exact source establishes a universal preference.
ABC.B: Two energized bars with coupler closed can be a normal operational mode; it is not necessarily obligatory.
ABC.C: Two energized bars with coupler warm reserve can be a normal regime; but no confirmed blanket preference without station design.

references.qualification: Text describes two feasible operating regimes; non-official and not an exam key.

cases.next_gate: Identify relevant substation design source paragraph and applicable scheme/automation conditions; authenticate conflicting Grade I A and Grade II C scored answers.

source_original_stem_ABC.stem: Mărimea caracteristică care reprezintă variaţia pe care o suferă amplitudinea şi faza undei de tensiune sau curent când parcurge 1 km de linie (lungă ) se numeşte:

cases.original_question_scope: Original says a 'mărime adimensională' for amplitude+phase evolution per 1 km, edited Trainer says 'mărimea caracteristică'.
cases.math_proof: Complex propagation constant gamma=alpha+j beta has units inverse length (m^-1 or km^-1), whereas gamma*L is dimensionless exponent in exp(-gamma L).
cases.negative_test: With gamma=(1+j2)/km and L=1 km, gamma itself is NOT dimensionless even though gamma L is.

ABC.A: Propagation constant describes both attenuation and phase; answers the intended phenomenon but not the original adjective 'adimensională'.
ABC.B: Attenuation alpha describes magnitude change, not both magnitude and phase.
ABC.C: 'Distortion constant' is not the standard complex line parameter gamma used for magnitude and phase.

references.qualification: The propagation constant definition and unit are directly stated; no ANRE scoring authority.

cases.next_gate: Exact original course/bibliography definition; official source answer or erratum for original 'adimensională'. Link QABC-0568 same source row.

source_original_stem_ABC.stem: Un corp conductor situat într-un câmp electric de intensitate E se încarcă cu electricitate:

cases.original_question_scope: Original B says 'inducţie electromagnetică', edited Trainer B 'inducţie electrostatică'; neutral conductor in E field redistributes surface charge but may remain net neutral.
cases.math_proof: For an isolated neutral conductor in an external static E field, total net charge Q_total remains 0 while surface free charge distribution polarizes. An induced net charge requires additional conditions such as contact with ground and subsequent separation.
cases.negative_test: Conductor insulated from ground in a uniform external electrostatic E: induced surface charges ± redistribute without changing net Q; so 'se încarcă' is ambiguous between separation and nonzero net charge.

ABC.A: 'Prin conducţie' requires charge transfer/contact; not entailed merely by being placed in an external field.
ABC.B: 'Prin inducţie electromagnetică' does not name electrostatic induction and, even with a revised word, neutral polarization does not automatically mean net charging.
ABC.C: 'Prin magnetizare' is not the stipulated electrostatic mechanism.

references.qualification: Conductor in external E redistributes surface charge.
Electrostatic polarization versus actual net charge by grounding/induction sequence.

cases.next_gate: Authenticate exact Romanian textbook definition of 'se încarcă cu electricitate', induction type and true 2024 ANRE-original answer key.
